items.label: Pre-Check Before Purchase — Fits 12V Cigarette Lighter Socket Only
items.value: The LISEN 4-in-1 Retractable Car Charger is designed exclusively for standard 12V cigarette lighter sockets (NOT USB ports). Before ordering, please confirm your vehicle has a working, powered cigarette lighter socket. ⚠️ This car charger does NOT support CarPlay, Bluetooth, or data transfer — it is a dedicated charging-only accessory. Not compatible with Micro-USB devices. Retractable cable length: extends up to 31.5 inches (80cm); charger body diameter: fits most standard socket openings. A reliable car accessory for every adventure.

items.label: 84W 4-Port Output — Know Your Ports Before You Plug In
items.value: This retractable car charger features a 45W PD USB-C port, a 12W USB-A port, and two additional retractable cables — one Type-C Cable and one Old model Apple Charging Cable). Total simultaneous output up to 84W across 4 devices. Note: Actual charging speed depends on your device, cable condition, and vehicle power supply — results may vary. Retraction Instructions: Pull cable out fully → connect your device → to retract, pull gently 1cm further, then release for automatic retraction. A clean, clutter-free car organization solution for daily drivers.

items.label: Clutter-Free Design — Real Specs, No Surprises
items.value: The dual retractable cables extend up to 31.5 inches, making them ideal for reaching rear passengers or center console setups without messy cords. Built with a 180° adjustable angle and military-grade stable base for reliable power on rough roads. ⚠️ Compatible with 12V cigarette lighter sockets only — not compatible with USB-only ports or power outlet sockets. Always verify your vehicle supports a 12V socket before purchase. Compatible with iPhone 17 / 16 / 15 / 14 / 13 / 12 / 11 / X series (Plus / Pro / Pro Max / Air) and Samsung Galaxy S26 / S25 / S24 and more. A must-have among road trip essentials and truck accessories.

items.label: The Perfect Gift for Every Driver — Mother's Day, Father's Day & Beyond
items.value: Searching for unique Mother's Day gifts 2026 or practical Father's Day gifts for dad? This retractable car charger is the ultimate thoughtful car accessory — for mom, wife, grandma, daughter, or anyone who drives. As mothers day gifts from son, daughter-in-law, or partner, it solves the daily cable chaos in a single plug. It also makes a great gift for new drivers, truckers, and road-trippers. Easy to use, easy to gift — comes ready in packaging with a full contents checklist (charger body × 1, user manual × 1). No complicated setup. Just plug in, pull out, and charge.

items.label: LISEN CARE PROMISE — We've Got You Covered
items.value: If your charger lights up but isn't charging, first confirm your cigarette lighter socket is powered (check your vehicle fuse) and that the cable type matches your device. If the issue persists, contact us for a free replacement — no return needed. Mild warmth during charging is normal; if you notice unusual heat or odor, stop use immediately and reach out. Backed by a 24-month replacement promise and responsive customer support. Bulk orders available for fleet and business accounts via Amazon Business — standardize your company vehicles with a reliable, consistent car charging solution. Not just a car charger — a long-term road companion.
